title: Two more holdouts are the Pascal machine in a mirror, reduced in Lean to its list program
text: 1RB1RA_1LC0RF_1LD1LC_1LE0LB_0LF---_1RA1RB and 1RB1RC_1RC1RB_1LD0RA_1LE1LD_1LF0LC_0LA--- are the table of 1RB0RE_0RC---_1LD1LE_1LE1LD_1RF0LC_1RA1RF read in a mirror, started in its states D and C. Lean now carries that machine's whole development over by one mirror theorem: each bounce is a row of Pascal's triangle mod 2, an odd frozen block halts, and each machine never halts if the Pascal machine's list program never fails from its own start state (EO [b,a,b,a,a,a] none 0, and EO [b,a,b,a] none 1). A new Lean file shows that program can fail in only three ways. It ran 40,000 list steps from both starts without failing.
